= Ditaa Block

Ditaa is on SUPPORTED_TYPES, so this file exists to keep that entry honest. The list
answers "which diagrams does this image render out of the box?", and an earlier version
of it answered wrongly in both directions -- it claimed ditaa could not be rendered while
the gem's jar sat in the image, and claimed a `c4plantuml` block type that has never
existed.
